sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 70 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

supersedes.reason: At the independently documented crossover bridge, inner vertices 29 and 30 follow the opposite edge of the lower road across the bridge footprint, producing an approximately 8.35 m excursion. Delete only these two pinned coordinates to connect the retained lower-road edge endpoints across the occluded 10.65 m interval. The native crop and original/corrected overlays were inspected. Every other coordinate and original border property remains exact. This is an estimated 2D continuation beneath the bridge, not a measured hidden edge or bridge elevation.

borderInference.note: Reviewed deletion of the pinned source vertices only. Every retained coordinate and original border property is unchanged. Each paint-line group has a near return and bounded local excursion. A bridge-occlusion group is limited to eight vertices, a 30-metre chord and a 15-metre excursion at a pinned, independently reviewed grade-separated source crossing; the complete retained edges must admit a non-folding source-order ribbon. This is a two-dimensional repair and assigns no road heights. Any numerical-loop group replaces an actual self-crossing with a chord at most two metres long and at most ten centimetres from every deleted point. The image supports local pavement interpretation but cannot resolve subpixel loops; this is not a new edge extraction or validation of the remaining source geometry.
